# GSAP

`gsap.min.js` is the locally bundled GSAP 3.15.0 distribution from the official
npm `gsap` package. Its copyright and standard-license notice are retained at
the top of the file. Source and license: https://gsap.com/standard-license

Update using `npm install gsap --save-exact`, then copy the package's
`dist/gsap.min.js` here. The website loads this local file without a CDN.
